_note: States that protect lawful source of income (including Section 8 / Housing Choice Vouchers). rule carries the citation inline.
_notice: General reference, not legal advice. Statutes change and vary by jurisdiction; verify every figure against the current official state code before relying on it. Last reviewed 2026-05.

CA.rule: Cal. Gov. Code § 12955(a) and (p): SB 329 (eff. 2020): source of income includes federal, state, or local housing subsidies (including Section 8/HCV and HUD-VASH)

CO.rule: Colo. Rev. Stat. § 24-34-502(1)(a): HB 20-1332 added source of income protection

CT.rule: Conn. Gen. Stat. § 46a-64c(a)(1)(F): lawful source of income protected

DC.rule: D.C. Code § 2-1402.21(a)(1): 'source of income' is protected class; includes vouchers

DE.rule: Del. Code tit. 6 § 4603(b)(1): source of income protected

HI.rule: Haw. Rev. Stat. § 489-3 (source of income / federal housing subsidies)

IL.rule: 775 ILCS 5/3-102 (source of income includes voucher under Cook County, Chicago, Urbana, statewide HB 2775 eff. 2023)

MA.rule: M.G.L. ch. 151B § 4(10): 'recipient of any federal, state, or local housing subsidy' protected

MD.rule: Md. Code, State Gov't § 20-705 (HOME Act, eff. 2020): source of income protected statewide

MI.rule: Mich. Comp. Laws (limited; some local: e.g., Detroit, Ann Arbor, Ypsilanti)

ND.rule: N.D. Cent. Code § 14-02.5-02 (source of income limited; check current)

NJ.rule: N.J.S.A. 10:5-12(g): source of lawful income protected

NY.rule: NY Exec. Law § 296(5)(a): 'lawful source of income' protected statewide (2019)

RI.rule: R.I. Gen. Laws § 34-37-4: source of income protected

VA.rule: Va. Code § 36-96.3(B): source of funds protected statewide (eff. 2020)

VT.rule: 9 V.S.A. § 4503: receipt of public assistance protected

WA.rule: Wash. Rev. Code § 59.18.255: source of income protected; voucher cannot be refused
